Colombia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina do not need an entry visa when traveling to the Republic of Colombia for a period of up to 90 days. This period may be extended by an additional 90 days, whereby the total stay for citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina on the territory of the Republic of Colombia without a visa during one calendar year cannot be longer than 180 days.
Citizens of the Republic of Colombia are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days in any period of 180 days, which means taking into account the period of 180 days preceding each day of stay.
